summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia filed a Form 6-K furnishing a material-event notice to Argentina's CNV and the SEC. Its subsidiary Banco Galicia, as successor to HSBC Bank Argentina (later Banco GGAL), was notified September 9, 2026 of a consumer class action, ACYMA v. HSBC Bank Argentina S.A., in National Commercial Court No. 17, Secretariat No. 34, Buenos Aires. The suit challenges alleged improper replacement-card fees on cards reported stolen or robbed. The bank is reviewing the claim and estimates no significant impact on shareholders' equity if decided unfavorably.
